hydra_config_path:
seed: 42
n_seeds: 5
experiment_name: s0_srconly_mlp
paths:
  data_root: ${oc.env:CHERENKOV_DATA_ROOT,data}
  results_root: ${oc.env:CHERENKOV_RESULTS_ROOT,results}
mlflow:
  tracking_uri: file:./mlruns
  experiment_name: cherenkov-sim2real
scenario:
  name: S0
  data_dir: data/raw/cta_prod5/dl1
  perturbation_intensity: 1.0
  split_ratios:
  - 0.7
  - 0.15
  - 0.15
  subsample: null
method:
  name: srconly
classifier: mlp_shallow
classifier_params:
  hidden_layer_sizes:
  - 64
  - 32
  activation: relu
  solver: adam
  alpha: 0.0001
  batch_size: 256
  max_iter: 200
  early_stopping: true
  validation_fraction: 0.1
model:
  name: logistic_regression
output_dir: results/s0_srconly_mlp
